title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Advance and Short-Notice Booking Adjustment (2026-27)
content:
**Clause.** The board-approved 2026-27 booked-day fee schedule of the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program applies a booking adjustment to a booked day. The adjustment follows the calendar days between the receipt of the drop-in booking request and the requested date:

- **at least 14 days ahead:** the advance adjustment of -3.00, so 3.00 is taken off;
- **no more than 6 days ahead:** the short-notice adjustment of 5.00, so 5.00 is added;
- **otherwise (7 through 13 days ahead):** no adjustment.

The receipt is the date the request was received, as shown on the request. The requested date is the day of care the request asks for.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical request received on the 1st of a month)

| Requested date | Calendar days ahead | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| the 7th | 6 | 5.00 added |
| the 8th | 7 | none |
| the 14th | 13 | none |
| the 15th | 14 | 3.00 taken off |
| the 29th | 28 | 3.00 taken off |
